description: Check text against brand voice rules. Give text and rules (a string of plain lines, or a JSON object, or an array). Understood rules: banned words or phrases, preferred terms ('use sign in not log in', or 'log in -> sign in'), required capitalisation of product names, sentence case or title case for headings (markdown # lines or heading: prefixes), a maximum sentence length in words, banned punctuation (exclamation marks, em-dashes, ellipses, emoji, ampersands, all caps), required terms, and tone words to avoid ('tone to avoid: salesy'). Rules are parsed forgivingly and echoed back so a misread rule can be corrected. Returns violations with line number, offending text, the rule and a suggested replacement, plus the rules that never matched anything.

rules.description: Voice rules: plain lines (one rule per line) or a JSON object such as {"banned": [...], "preferred": {"log in": "sign in"}, "products": [...], "headings": "sentence", "maxSentenceWords": 20, "punctuation": ["!"], "required": [...], "tone": [...]}

text.description: The copy to check. Use # lines or 'heading:' prefixes to mark headings.

name: lint_brand_voice
title: Brand voice
